tagline: Sourced, dated facts about Icelandic campsites for campervan and motorhome travellers

regions.name: Capital area
regions.blurb: Reykjavík and the surrounding towns (Kópavogur, Hafnarfjörður, Garðabær, Mosfellsbær).

regions.name: Reykjanes
regions.blurb: The peninsula around Keflavík International Airport, including Grindavík, Sandgerði and Garður.

regions.name: West Iceland
regions.blurb: Akranes, Borgarnes, Snæfellsnes and the Dalir district.

regions.name: Westfjords
regions.blurb: Ísafjörður, Patreksfjörður, Þingeyri, Hólmavík and the fjords in between.

regions.name: North West
regions.blurb: Hvammstangi, Blönduós, Skagaströnd, Sauðárkrókur and the Skagafjörður area.

regions.name: North East
regions.blurb: Akureyri, Mývatn, Húsavík, Siglufjörður and the north-east coast.

regions.name: East Iceland
regions.blurb: Egilsstaðir, Seyðisfjörður, the Eastfjords and Djúpivogur.

regions.name: South Iceland
regions.blurb: Hveragerði and Selfoss east along the Ring Road to Vík, Skaftafell and Höfn, plus the Golden Circle.

themes.name: Open in winter
themes.blurb: Campsites whose own published information (or an official listing) says they take campers in winter. Status is shown exactly as sourced; 'call ahead' means the source uses vague wording such as 'depending on weather' or 'upon request'.

themes.name: Dump stations / chemical toilet disposal by region
themes.blurb: Campsites where a source confirms a disposal point for chemical (cassette) toilets and/or grey water, grouped by region. Sites where disposal is unconfirmed or absent are not listed here.
